title: 2，这该死的毛熊啊。
slug: 人在俄乌当佣兵杀敌就能爆属性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

你是愿意当个无名之辈，一辈子安生，插着尿管死在床上，还是就算活不到三十岁，也要名留青史呢？

如果这个问题让沈飞来回答。

他两个都不选。

他的人生就应该每天早上从八百平米的大床上，被金发洋马的柰子夹醒。

最好一睁眼，还能看见阳光、沙滩、游艇、伏特加，以及一群肤白貌美大长腿的漂亮姑娘围着自己喊老板早上好。

这才叫人生。

可惜，理想很丰满，现实很毛熊。

沈飞身边没有金发大洋马，没有黑丝御姐，没有温柔人妻，更没有白毛兽耳娘。

有的只是各式各样的毛熊壮汉，还有一个每天晚上说梦话都用俄语喊着你好香的室友。

那眼神，

沈飞至今想起来都觉得后背发凉。

要不是他够狠.....

要不是他有钱贿赂狱警，外加懂得什么时候该把磨尖的牙刷藏进袖子里，他现在估计早就已经清白不保，人生提前进入地狱难度。

沈飞抬起头，看向不远处，普利维奇已经结束演讲，在几名武装人员的簇拥下，钻进了一辆黑色越野车。

车身方正，线条硬朗，气场很足。

是坦克500。

沈飞觉得他是个好人，车都开华夏产的，不像车臣那帮家伙，动不动就是路虎、奔驰大G，俗。

他觉得自己也是个好人。

“好人就该跟好人待在一起。”

“我要加入瓦格纳！”

这个理由很扯淡，扯淡到沈飞自己都想笑。

但沈飞心里很清楚，他其实只是需要一个理由来说服自己去巴河穆特拼一把。

至于这个理由到底是系统来了，还是坦克500看着顺眼，又或者那个人是个开华夏车的好人，其实已经没那么重要了。

不就是死吗？

他又不是没死过。

作为一个穿越者，沈飞对死亡这件事的接受能力，比一般人高那么一点点。

大不了再穿一次。

说不定下个异世界待遇更好，开局就是精灵女王倒贴，魅魔女仆暖床，圣女半夜敲门说勇者大人请惩罚我。

想想还有点小期待。

拿定主意之后，沈飞不再犹豫，默默跟着前方的惩戒军向前移动。

在瓦格纳士兵的指挥下，这群刚刚被煽动得热血上头的重刑犯，被赶到了操场另一侧的临时登记处。

那里早就摆好了八张桌子。

每张桌子后面都坐着一名瓦格纳军官。

旁边还站着监狱狱警。

桌面上放着一摞摞文件、印泥、钢笔，还有装在牛皮纸袋里的犯人档案。

每张桌子前面，都排着长长的队伍。

有人兴奋得满脸通红。

有人紧张得不断舔嘴唇。

战场那种地方，没去过，也总归在电视上见过。

炮弹落下来，说死就死。

没什么商量余地。

这帮人是重刑犯，不是傻子，他们当然知道自己不是去度假。

大家的心情就跟第一次去洗脚的小男生差不多。

又紧张，又激动.......

沈飞扫了一圈，很快在一张桌子旁边看到了熟人。

谢廖沙。

一个留着灰色胡茬，鼻子有点红，看起来永远像宿醉未醒的狱警。

这货平时负责沈飞所在那片牢区。

职业素养一般，贪财水平一流。

但他也是个好人，

因为谢廖沙真的拿钱就办事，至少到目前为止，沈飞的清白还能保住，这货功不可没。

沈飞默默走到谢廖沙对应的那张桌子前排队。

谢廖沙显然也看见了他。

两人目光对上的瞬间，沈飞很自然地抬了抬下巴，算是打招呼。

谢廖沙却板着脸，面无表情，仿佛从来没见过沈飞。

Would you rather be an unknown person, live in peace for the rest of your life, and die in bed with a urinary catheter inserted, or would you rather leave your name in history even if you don't live to be thirty?

If Shen Fei were to answer this question.

He chose neither.

In his life, he should wake up every morning from the big bed of 800 square meters, and be pinched by the napkin of a blond horse.

It would be best if you open your eyes and see the sun, the beach, the yacht, vodka, and a group of beautiful girls with fair skin and long legs surrounding you and saying good morning to your boss.

This is called life.

Unfortunately, the ideal is very full, and the reality is very ugly.

There is no blond horse, no black stocking lady, no gentle wife, and no white-haired lady with animal ears beside Shen Fei.

There are just all kinds of strong men with furry bears, and there is also a roommate who talks in his sleep every night and shouts in Russian that you smell good.

That look,

Shen Fei still feels chills on his back just thinking about it.

If he wasn't cruel enough...

If he hadn't had the money to bribe the prison guards and knew when to hide the sharpened toothbrush in his sleeve, he would have been innocent by now, and his life would have entered hell early.

Shen Fei raised his head and looked not far away. Privich had finished his speech and got into a black off-road vehicle surrounded by several armed men.

The body is square, with tough lines and full of aura.

It's a tank 500.

Shen Fei thinks that he is a good person. He drives cars made in China, unlike those guys in Chechnya who always drive Land Rover, Mercedes-Benz and Big G. They are vulgar.

He thinks he is also a good person.

"Good people should stay with good people."

"I want to join Wagner!"

This reason is so nonsense that Shen Fei himself wants to laugh.

But Shen Fei knew very well that he actually just needed a reason to convince himself to go to Bahemut and give it a try.

As for whether the reason is the system, the Tank 500 looks pleasing to the eye, or the person is a good person who drives a Chinese car, it is actually not that important anymore.

Isn't it just death?

It's not like he never died.

As a time traveler, Shen Fei's ability to accept death is a little higher than the average person.

Worst case, wear it again.

Maybe the treatment in the next different world will be better. At the beginning, the elf queen will turn against me, the succubus maid will warm the bed, and the saint will knock on the door in the middle of the night and say, brave man, please punish me.

Come to think of it, I still have a little expectation.

After making up his mind, Shen Fei no longer hesitated and silently followed the punishment army ahead.

Under the command of Wagner's soldiers, this group of newly incited felons were driven to the temporary registration office on the other side of the playground.

Eight tables had already been set up there.

Behind each desk sat a Wagner officer.

There was also a prison guard standing nearby.

On the table were stacks of documents, ink pads, pens, and prisoner files in brown paper bags.

There was a long queue in front of every table.

Some people were so excited that their faces were red.

Some people were so nervous that they kept licking their lips.

I have never been to a place like a battlefield, but I have always seen it on TV.

The shells fell and they died.

There is no room for negotiation.

These guys were felons, not fools, and they certainly knew they weren't on vacation.

Everyone's mood was similar to that of a little boy who went to wash his feet for the first time.

Nervous and excited...

Shen Fei glanced around and soon saw an acquaintance next to a table.

Seryosha.

One had gray stubble and a slightly red nose, looking like a perpetually hungover prison guard.

This guy is usually responsible for the prison area where Shen Fei is.

His professional quality is average and his greed for money is top-notch.

But he's also a good guy,

Because Seryozha really does things for money, at least so far, Shen Fei's innocence can be maintained, and this guy has played a big role.

Shen Fei silently walked to the table corresponding to Seryozha and lined up.

Seryozha apparently saw him too.

The moment their eyes met, Shen Fei naturally raised his chin as a greeting.

But Seryozha had a straight face, expressionless, as if he had never seen Shen Fei before.
